comments.text: url_normalizer.cr:106 — Regex.new with (&|$) anchor boundary. Catseye flags nested quantifiers but the (&|$) creates a natural stop point that prevents unbounded backtracking. Query strings are typically short (under 2000 chars per HTTP spec). The ReDoS detector should recognize anchored alternation patterns as safe.

title: FP: ReDoS false positive on regex with (&|$) stop anchor
